mapper.sql: id, reconciliation_date, provider, payment_no, provider_transaction_id, internal_amount_minor, provider_amount_minor, internal_status, provider_status, difference_type, process_status, assignee_user_id, note, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_reconciliation_item SET process_status = 'RESOLVED', assignee_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, note = #{note}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = #{resolvedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_reconciliation_item ( id, reconciliation_date, provider, payment_no, provider_transaction_id, internal_amount_minor, provider_amount_minor, internal_status, provider_status, difference_type, process_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{reconciliationDate}, #{provider}, #{paymentNo}, #{providerTransactionId}, #{internalAmountMinor}, #{providerAmountMinor}, #{internalStatus}, #{providerStatus}, #{differenceType}, #{processStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE internal_amount_minor = VALUES(internal_amount_minor), provider_amount_minor = VALUES(provider_amount_minor), internal_status = VALUES(internal_status), provider_status = VALUES(provider_status), process_status = VALUES(process_status), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
